rows.text: terminates its 8-Sep MoU to sell the Baheri (Bareilly) sugar undertaking to Avadh Foods and Multi Warehouse after the buyer defaulted on payments; the undertaking stays with the Company, which will pursue legal action.

rows.quant: Rs 431.00 cr before liabilities; ~431.5% of mcap
rows.text: approves the **slump sale of its Baheri sugar, distillery and cogeneration undertaking to Avadh Foods and Multi Warehouse for Rs 431 crore**, which the filing says is before the undertaking's liabilities
